title: Upstage provider v3 — async curl_cffi rewrite
summary: 'New Upstage Change Logs/' contains a v3 rewrite of the Upstage provider that removes requests, DrissionPage, and thread bridges in favour of a single asyncio loop over curl_cffi AsyncSession, plus a pytest suite, an interactive REPL, and a usage demo.

facts.claim: Four files: upstage_provider.py (1374 lines), test_upstage.py (865), upstage_interactive.py (403), upstage_usage.py (207).

v3 docstring states the design goal: '100% asyncio - one event loop, zero thread bridges', 'curl_cffi ONLY - Chrome TLS impersonation', 'NO requests - NO DrissionPage - NO threads - NO fake hi prompt'. It notes v2 ran the completion stream in a worker thread with plain requests + queue polling.

v3's public method set is a strict superset of v2's. All 40 method names found in Upstage.py also appear in upstage_provider.py; v3 adds stream, _events_with_retry, _cookies_from, and the usage classes TurnUsage/SessionUsage/ThinkSplitter/StreamEvent.
evidence: rg -o '^    (async )?def (\w+)' on both files, sorted and diffed

facts.claim: Both versions expose the same class name UpstageProvider and the same fluent setters set_model/set_system/set_search/set_temperature/set_max_tokens, plus connect, chat, close, refresh_credentials, clear_credentials, list_models, available_models, model_info, get_sources*, new_session, clear_history, get_history.

v3 signature changes exist below the surface: _SSE.parse_line(line) returns List[Tuple[str,str]] in v3 vs Optional[Tuple[str,str]] with an in_think accumulator in v2; _Creds.__init__ takes Optional[Path]=None in v3 vs a module-level _CRED_FILE default in v2. A drop-in swap therefore needs review, not blind copying.

test_upstage.py splits into an always-runnable offline suite (parser, splitter, sources, models, payload, stream assembly from canned events, creds, usage) and a live suite gated on UPSTAGE_LIVE=1 (connect, realtime stream, search, multi-turn, fresh credential capture). Intended runner: python3 -m pytest test_upstage.py -v.
Neither pytest nor curl_cffi is installed in this sandbox, so no part of the v3 suite has been executed. Zero runtime evidence exists for v3 behaviour.
evidence: python3 -m pip list -> only pip, setuptools, wheel

facts.claim: v3 does not import DrissionPage; the only DrissionPage import in the repo is Upstage.py line 44 ('from DrissionPage import ChromiumPage, ChromiumOptions'). If v3 replaces v2, DrissionPage plus chromium, chromium-driver and xvfb become removable from requirements.txt and the Dockerfile.
evidence: rg -n -i drissionpage across repo: 9 matches in 4 files; only one is a Python import
